content:
The highly anticipated fourth season of Ted Lasso is now streaming on Apple TV+, performing strongly, but in the short term there are three other exciting new releases on the horizon.

#1: Dark Matter

Apple TV+ has plenty of great offerings for sci-fi fans. Beyond widely known titles like Severance and Pluribus, there is a fan favourite you may have missed — Dark Matter.

Adapted from the bestselling novel by Blake Crouch, the show stars Joel Edgerton and Jennifer Connelly.

Season 2 of Dark Matter will premiere on Friday, August 28, with new episodes released weekly until October 30.

Here is the official synopsis from Apple:

#2: Mayday

Apple TV+ has several new releases this autumn, most of which will debut first on the streaming platform rather than in cinemas.

Kicking things off is Mayday, an action-comedy starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh, offering a fresh take on the classic spy genre.

Mayday will have its exclusive streaming premiere on Apple TV+ on Friday, September 4.

Here is the official synopsis and trailer from Apple:

#3: Slow Horses

One of Apple's most acclaimed series, Slow Horses, is set to return.

In the streaming era, viewers often have to wait several years between seasons. But Slow Horses has maintained a yearly release rhythm, with Gary Oldman as Jackson Lamb leading his team through another round of gripping espionage.

Season 6 of Slow Horses will premiere on Wednesday, September 16, with new episodes released weekly until October 21.

Apple TV+ costs US$12.99 per month, or you can subscribe as part of an Apple One bundle for a discounted price.
